name: researchzy-language
description: Academic translation and language polishing with your agent: numbers, citations, LaTeX and terms kept exactly, a glossary, side-by-side output, edits limited to language with a reason for each, and scripts that check nothing in the content changed. No account needed.

interface.longDescription: Translate a manuscript section or a paper, Chinese to English and back or between other languages, with numbers, units, citations, LaTeX commands, placeholders and terms kept exactly, a glossary, and side-by-side output a script checks against the source. Polish academic English at the level you choose, with a reason for every change, optionally in your own voice or a target journal's conventions, and a script that proves numbers, citations and the strength of claims did not change. Works on the files you give it; no Researchzy account needed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Translate the Methods section of my Chinese manuscript into academic English and keep every number and citation.
